title: Show HN: Lightscale AI – A language for LLMs to write business software
description: I am Luc, one of the co-founders of Lightscale AI. I have background in programming languages (ETH Zurich) and we are small team in Zug, Switzerland. As more and more code is now written by LLMs and few people have time to review the generated code, we came up with the idea to revise the actual stack below the LLMs: The programming language with its compiler and runtime system, all designed from scratch for AI authorship, not for humans. We have three goals: 1. Security and stability by language design: Some classes of errors are removed by abstraction as the AI never writes that code, but the compiler and runtime implement it fully. Others are reduced by rigid compiler checks and very strict language rules (no fun for humans to code). 2. Speed. We designed the language to reduce tokens, by throwing out a lot of complexity and legacy of classical languages. Our target is about a minute from prompt to deployment on average. 3. AI cost. The language is designed for mid-tier LLMs, with little or no reasoning effort. This is why we can offer prompting for free (no credit, but account sign-up is needed).
